title: Aurore
body:
Description

Aurore is a type of special ore that only spawns in the Icelands during an aurora, and can only be mined with an Auroracrest Pickaxe

In it's refined state, this is called "Ore" but when forged, it goes back to its original name of "Aurore"

Appearance

The ore itself is a pink (7e018f) translucent material. When refined, it becomes semi-translucent and takes on the Roblox Lego texture. The forged version loses all transparency and becomes a violent hot pink

When used in a schematic, the base stone retains its transparency and the forged version retains all its properties

As of 1.71.0, the forged version is very bugged, and when completed into a schematic, the schematic remains in its uncompleted color, but when moved or resized, it gives the wrong texture, similar to sanded birch, except more white, and can also be resized to be any size if the schematic is completed, regardless of how much material is in the schematic.
